title: fix: output Vercel API bundle as .js instead of .mjs
body:
Vercel's `@vercel/node` ignores the pre-bundled `api/index.mjs` and compiles `api/index.ts` from source. The resulting `api/index.js` resolves `@objectstack/metadata` via pnpm workspace symlinks to `src/index.ts`, which doesn't exist in the deployed function → `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.

### Changes

- **`scripts/bundle-api.mjs`**: Output to `api/index.js` instead of `api/index.mjs`. Studio's `package.json` has `"type": "module"`, so `.js` = ESM. Vercel picks up the self-contained bundle directly — no TypeScript recompilation, no workspace symlink resolution.
- **`.gitignore`**: Add `api/index.js` and `api/index.js.map` (build artifacts)

```diff
-  outfile: 'api/index.mjs',
+  outfile: 'api/index.js',
```
